summary: Batch 87 (Heatmap Drilldown, Escalation Digest, Per-Hour Digest, Exec SLA Banner) tested end-to-end. All 16 backend pytest tests pass. All frontend flows verified via Playwright on /app and /app/system-health with admin cookie login.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> inside <option> for the sh-sched-hour select. Root cause is the Emergent dev overlay wrapping option text in an x-dynamic span; not a code bug in SystemHealth.jsx (option children are simple strings). No functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: deploy_audit.py is ~1300 lines - consider splitting (config endpoints, room endpoints, comments/rollups) into submodules for maintainability. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Toggled one audit comment to Resolved then back to Open to preserve the 'one open remains' invariant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints for audit config are under /api/deploy/{sla-config,escalation-config,reply-templates,digest-schedule} (NOT prefixed with 'audit-'). Status update on comments is POST /api/deploy/audit-room-comments/{id}/status with status values 'Open'|'In Progress'|'Resolved' (title-case). SLA-config PUT body uses {sla_hours: int}. Digest schedule: {enabled, days:[0..6], hour:0..23} — no run_hour_utc. Heatmap rows are BUTTON elements with testids 'sh-heatmap-row-<label>'; clicking Room row sets sh-inbox-room-filter to the room token and sh-inbox-status-filter to 'Open'. SLA banner (sap-sla-banner) currently hidden because open_overdue/breached_7d/escalated_7d are all 0 in demo data — endpoint verified 200 with three int fields; 401 unauth. Hourly cron /api/cron/hourly-overdue-digest returns 401 without auth header (verified). Restored to defaults: digest enabled=true days=[0..6] hour=8; escalation enabled=false contacts=[]; org SLA 72h.
